title: Plastic
text: Plastic. I got these in glass and loved them. They were the perfect food storage! I love the glass ones. These are not glass. The entire thing is plastic. I don't know why they put the silicone covers on plastic, that seems unnecessary. They look *exactly* like the glass version. But I'd rather not store my food in plastic.

product_metadata.title: Ello Plastic Rectangle Multi-Size Food Storage Meal Prep Containers with Airtight Leak-Proof Locking Lids, 10pc Set, Fruit Cobbler
features: WHAT'S INSIDE: Reusable plastic 10 piece set includes (1) 5oz condiment cup, (1) 1 cup, (1) 2 cup, (1) 4 cup, & (1) 6.2 cup. Meal prep for the week or store your leftovers - there's a container for every one of your needs. Threaded lid on condiment cup screws on to ensure your food stays airtight and mess-free. Easily pack your salad dressings, sauces, toppings or dips with no worry about leaks.

MIGHTY TOUGH: PP Plastic with are overmolded with a soft base. The color matching lids ensure you can always easily spot and pair with the protective silicone sleeve base. Protective sleeve can take a hit no matter what your lunch box (or your kid) throws at it! Easily stack and organize your set in your fridge or pantry.

JUST A LIL' MORE: 10pc set covers all your needs! Use to meal prep, control portions, kids lunches and leftovers. Easy to travel plastic has got your hunger covered at home, work, & even the gym. Condiment cup is perfectly sized for hummus, nut butter, dips and more! Not limited to food - use it to store and organize all your household items.
CLEAN, SAFE, GREEN: Contribute to eco- friendly green living! Ditch the disposable plastic and reuse. All parts are BPA free. Our sleeve and lid seal are made of FDA food grade silicone.
EASY CARE: Easily pop these containers in the dishwasher when your lunch break is done. Top rack washing recommended. Microwave Safe without the lid.
description: MAKE FOOD STORAGE FUN!The 10pc Plastic Food Storage brings Ello’s signature design details into plastic. Save time and money by meal prepping or storing leftovers in this multi-size plastic food storage set. Bright colors easily color-match with the lids. Simply stack and organize in your fridge or pantry with the ease of skid-free soft base that protects the plastic. This 10pc plastic food storage set includes 5 food storage containers with leak-proof, airtight lids and silicone protection. Simply your life and get every every size of your food storage needs covered! All parts dishwasher safe and you do not need to remove sleeve for cleaning. Microwave and oven safe without lid - no need to remove sleeve. Freezer safe - leave room for expansion in when freezing.
